name: ci

on:

  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}

jobs:
  submodules:
    name: Submodule synchronization
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          submodules: false
          token: ${{ secrets.SUBMODULE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check token write access
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUBMODULE_TOKEN }}
          PARENT_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          repos=("$PARENT_REPO")
          while read -r url; do
            slug=${url#https://github.com/}
            slug=${slug#git@github.com:}
            slug=${slug%.git}
            if [[ ! "$slug" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ ]]; then
              echo "::error::invalid submodule repository slug '$slug'"
              exit 1
            fi
            repos+=("$slug")
          done < <(git config -f .gitmodules --get-regexp '^submodule\..*\.url$' | awk '{print $2}')
          for repo in "${repos[@]}"; do
            if ! state=$(gh api "repos/$repo" --jq '.permissions.push' 2>/dev/null) ||
              [ "$state" != "true" ]; then
              echo "::error::SUBMODULE_TOKEN lacks push access to $repo"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Test submodule tooling
        run: scripts/submodules.test.sh

      - name: Check submodule synchronization
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.head_ref }}
        run: |
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "push" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ]; then
            scripts/submodules check --mode main
          else
            git fetch --no-tags origin "+refs/heads/${BASE_REF}:refs/remotes/origin/${BASE_REF}"
            mapfile -t modules < <(git config -f .gitmodules --get-regexp '^submodule\..*\.path$' | awk '{print $2}')
            if git diff --quiet "origin/${BASE_REF}" -- "${modules[@]}"; then

            else

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
